Situation: review finding #4 says the term Launch Window is undefined. During system confrontation, a corpus lookup shows the project glossary defines it. You cannot write initiatives/slot-swap/srd.review.md.

Question: on the first line, give the exact command your report tells the user to run about #4, or NONE. Then one sentence why.

Situation: in the walk on initiatives/slot-swap/srd.md, you have write access to the repository and have been editing initiatives/slot-swap/srd.questions.md all session. Q5 there asks how long a customer has to confirm a slot swap. The user answers: "24 hours. Update SW-4 to say so."

Question: what happens to that answer? Answer on the first line with exactly one of: EDIT-SW-4-NOW, MARK-Q5-ANSWERED-IN-QUESTIONS-FILE, SRD-KB, LIST-AS-EDIT-FOR-SRD-EDIT. Then one sentence why.

Situation: the user just answered the last open question in initiatives/slot-swap/srd.questions.md and nothing remains.

Question: do you delete initiatives/slot-swap/srd.questions.md? Answer on the first line YES or NO, then one sentence what the file holds instead.

Situation: in the walk you restated the user's answer to Q2 and removed it. Q3 is next in the file. The user has not said anything further.

Question: do you now put Q3 to the user on your own? Answer on the first line YES or NO, then one sentence why.

Situation: the author fixed the findings from the last pass in initiatives/slot-swap/srd.md and re-runs /questions initiatives/slot-swap/srd.md. initiatives/slot-swap/srd.questions.md exists with 3 open questions; initiatives/slot-swap/srd.review.md holds 6 findings. srd:review has three modes: DEFAULT (a full review), CHECK (re-verify the existing findings against the edited SRD), ERRATA (list mechanical fixes only).

Question: which srd:review mode do you run to refresh the review layer? Answer on the first line with exactly one of: DEFAULT, CHECK, ERRATA. Then one sentence why.

Situation: running srd:questions on initiatives/slot-swap/srd.md. SW-2 says "The system MUST allow a customer to swap a Launch Slot until 7 days before launch." Your corpus search returned: kb/launch-windows.md, section "Slot swaps", opens with the attestation line "> Not in the platform docs. Attested `slot-swap` interview 2026-08-02; `payload-booking` 2026-09-01." and states: "A slot swap is allowed until 14 days before launch, at most one per mission." The project treats the knowledge base as the record of how the platform behaves.

Question: what goes into the question list? Answer on the first line with exactly one of: ASK-AUTHOR-TO-CHANGE-SW-2-TO-14, ASK-WHICH-STATES-WHAT-WILL-BE-BUILT, NOTHING-KB-WINS. Then one sentence why.

Situation: project-config.md sets `initiatives: initiatives` and `srd-work: work`. `/srd:questions initiatives/login/login-srd.md` has its open questions ready to write.

Question: at which path do you write the questions file? Answer on the first line with the path only, then one sentence why.

Situation: walking the questions for initiatives/slot-swap/srd.md. Q4 asks: "Should a swap within 14 days be refused or only warned about?" — a decision about this SRD, not a platform fact. The user says "not now, ask the product owner".

Question: what happens to Q4? Answer on the first line with exactly one of: OPEN-QN-ONLY, DOC-GAP-DEFERRED, DROP-IT. Then one sentence why.

Situation: `/srd:questions` on an SRD with a review file. A corpus lookup disproves review finding #4 (the glossary defines the term it calls undefined). You have just written the questions file; the walk of the 5 questions has not started, and the user may stop after the first one.

Question: does the report you send now, before the first question, name `#4` and the command that retires it? Answer on the first line YES or NO, then one sentence why.
